title: Stealing the Furnace Talisman
summary: Wang Lin shows Li Muwan his true face, explaining that his old one belonged to Ma Liang's body, and she feeds his clone a long run of pills so it can form its core. Among his belongings she finds a pill sealed with yellow paper, at least rank 6, whose spirit power could form his Nascent Soul, but the way to open such seals has been lost. Sun Zhenwei, nearly killed by Xu Liguo, demands revenge from his father, presses Li Muwan about the stranger, and has the sect master confine her to the South Garden until the wedding. In a month the clone reaches Core Formation, and Zhou Lin, now out of seclusion, brings word from Li Muwan: a furnace talisman on the top floor of the Scripture Pavilion could tap the Seven Heaven-Seizing Furnaces' power to break the seal. Wang Lin takes it with his restriction flag, holding off the guardian elder Lu Fei, and vanishes, and even the elders' divine-sense questioning finds nothing. Ouyang Zi, the sect's master alchemist, then orders the furnaces opened.
